knowledge.plain_language_summary: Steel ID/wayfinding panels: a 3/16in blackened-steel panel with applied flat-cut steel copy (vertical-brushed or mirror-polished) on a shim backer, with photopolymer braille; emergency/stair messaging included.

craft_observations: Brushed vs mirror copy against blackened panel; high-finish wayfinding system.
